title: Hardware Procurement Order Cancellation Rules
content:
**Before the purchase order.** An approved Hardware Procurement order may be cancelled free of charge before its purchase order is placed where the order type allows free cancellation before the purchase order, any deposit invoiced being credited in full.

**After the purchase order and before shipment.** After the purchase order is placed and before shipment, an order may be cancelled only where the order type allows cancellation after the purchase order. Whether the stage and the order type permit it is read from the order's system record: its status and its order type.

**Fee clause.** The clause "Such a cancellation is charged the order type's after-purchase-order cancellation fee percentage of the quote total, rounded half up to the cent, and any deposit paid is applied against that fee by an order credit with the excess refunded by the accounting team" is **no longer in force** as a rule for every order type. It no longer governs a Standard Endpoint Order, which is settled under the endpoint cancellation schedule, or a Network Equipment Order or Server & Storage Build Order, which is settled under the infrastructure cancellation and deposit-credit schedules. Every other order type's cancellation after its purchase order stays charged its after-purchase-order cancellation fee percentage of the quote total, rounded half up to the cent, with any deposit paid applied against that fee by an order credit and the excess refunded by the accounting team.

**Special-Order Equipment.** Special-Order Equipment is non-cancellable once approved, because its terms allow neither free cancellation before the purchase order nor cancellation after it.

**Shipped orders.** A shipped order cannot be cancelled; its units can only come back under the return rules.

## Stage table

| Order status when the client asks | Cancellation possible | Charge |
|---|---|---|
| Approved, purchase order not placed | Where the order type allows free cancellation before the purchase order | None; any deposit invoiced is credited in full |
| Ordered, not shipped | Only where the order type allows cancellation after the purchase order | As set by the fee clause above for the order type |
| Shipped or later | No | Units return only under the return rules |

**Hypothetical illustration.** A Staged Endpoint Order with a quote total of 8000.00 cancelled after its purchase order at its fee percentage of 15 is charged 1200.00. A paid deposit of 2000.00 on it is applied against that fee by an order credit, and the excess of 800.00 is refunded by the accounting team.

superseded_clauses: Such a cancellation is charged cancellation_after_po_fee_pct percent of the quote total, rounded half up to the cent, and any deposit paid is applied against that fee by an order credit with the excess refunded by the accounting team.
